description: Defines the class TrackerSessionsDatabaseStore which implements data storage for tracker sessions in SuiteCRM, including methods for flushing session data to the database.

classes.name: TrackerSessionsDatabaseStore
classes.description: Implements storage logic for tracker session data, including inserting and updating session records in the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Saves the monitor session data into the database, either inserting a new record or updating an existing one based on session properties.
